notes.title: Release 1.2.18
notes.notes:
Mostly changes to enemies and bug fixes for the achievements introduced in v1.1

Patch notes

By CalmPewter: Added escape button reactivity to settings menu in level selection and creation (#203)
By CalmPewter:  Fixed keys and chest sometimes not registering a collision when flying around with geysers (#202)
By CalmPewter: Added atslughorn to the list of credits  (#201)
By CalmPewter: Changed local level loading process to keep boards invisible until loaded and prevent level loading twice. (#206)
By yanniboi: Track totalScores and totalRatings locally when updated. (#205)
By CalmPewter: Various minor updates to adjust how UI elements scale with unusual resolutions. (#212)
Backend: Script to Delete Scores for Levels that are or were drafts
By yanniboi and jonathanulyatt: Fix achievements falling over when not in Game Play Scene.
By yanniboi: Dont try to submit scores for draft levels.
By yanniboi: Added jonathanulyatt to the list of credits
By CalmPewter: Enemy animation, sfx and behaviour improvements. (#213)
By CalmPewter: Changed cursor mode to ForceSoftware outside of the Unity editor as well to maintain a constant cursor size.

notes.title: Release 1.1.6
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:


 - By yanniboi: More barks. 
 - By atslughorn:  Fixed LevelLeaderboardTopped achievement in LeaderboardForm.cs (#191) 
 - By yanniboi: Updated twitch messages. 
 - By yanniboi: Removed a bunch of logging and prevent unpublished level scores
 - By Endocrine: Achievement restriction
 - By CalmPewter: Enemy animation, cursor and game icon, fix chest enemy triggers
 - By yanniboi: Tweaked overlay opacity
 - By Endocrine: Correct Qonfiguration bool description for lever block 
 -  By yanniboi: Added a refresh button to Leaderboard. 
 - By Fresch:  Geyser consistency.
 - By Endocrine: Lever channel shader (in-game)
 - By Endocrine: Editor level block channel visualisation (#196)
 - By yanniboi: Updated Leaderboard refresh button icon, show level code on leaderboard and added more barks.



Level Channel Overlay

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44678002/b5c3c53fb9d6e1b68e46467bd45dbda025a6f930.gif

You can now see ingame which level toggles which blocks with colours and numbers.

First time contribution

We were missing an achievement trigger for topping a leaderboard. @atslughorn found and fixed this for us (what a legend) and now if you are still top of a leaderboard you should be able to just view that leaderboard from the level selection page and you will unlock the achievement.
